individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of n=141 individual sample measurements (explicitly stated in caption); scatter plots are exempt since the points are already the individual data, and marginal histograms are also exempt.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the scatter plot or marginal histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each marker is a mean +/- SD of 6 replicate samples per reporter (per caption); this is an averaged summary and the underlying individual replicate measurements are not overlaid.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars (mean +/- SD) are defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: These are line/density (normal distribution) plots, a plot type exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on these fitted distribution curves.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement, and individual sample dots (Per2-Luc/Bmal1-Luc) are additionally overlaid.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histograms display the distribution of phase differences directly and are not a mean+error-bar type plot requiring an overlay of individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the polar histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; histogram-type distribution plot exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the polar histogram.

individual-data-points.explanation: Single illustrative example line plot of a fitted model (line plot), not an averaged summary across samples, exempt from the requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars appear in this single-example fitting illustration.

individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of n=117 individual samples, each point its own measurement with fit-derived uncertainty; scatter plots of individual samples are exempt.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are defined as the SD of the fitted parameters in the caption.
